---
title: "MAGiC Calibration and Validation Data"
---

This site reports the data used to calibrate and validate the SIPNET ecosystem model in the
MAGiC inventory runs for California cropland: measurements from six field sites, and evidence
from published syntheses of how soil carbon and greenhouse gas fluxes respond to management.

- [Overview & Key Points](reports/calibration-validation-data.qmd) summarises the two bodies of
  evidence, what each can support, and how they are used together.
- [Part A: Site-Level Data](reports/site-level-data.qmd) describes the six sites, when and what
  was measured, and the practice contrasts.
- [Part B: Statewide Evidence](reports/statewide-evidence.qmd) sets out the practice by outcome
  grid built from published syntheses, and which cells can be fitted.

The [Data Collection Protocol](docs/data-collection-protocol.qmd) and the
[Data Requirements](docs/data-requirements.qmd) describe how datasets are chosen and curated.
